## Fixed: Heating/cooling changeover sensor

The heating/cooling changeover sensor now shows the same mode as the free@home
room controllers: `1` means heating and `0` means cooling. These readings were
previously reversed. Climate entities are unchanged.

[Reported issue #397](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass/issues/397)

## New: Install through Marketplace or HACS search

ABB-free@home is now in the default catalog. Search for "ABB-free@home" in the
Home Assistant Marketplace (Home Assistant 2026.11 and newer) or HACS on older
versions; you no longer need to add a custom repository.

[Installation instructions](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#installation)
